spans.text: The garden is imbued with faint aroma. It smells of flowers and tea leaves.
Is this what it's like on Level II? It looks more realistic than I imagined.
This girl seems to be a neural cloud consciousness stored within this space. I can detect a massive torrent of data from her.
So have we found the culprit?
I would say so...but how could such a sweet girl be the nasty hacker that we're after?
She doesn't seem to have any motive for seizing the neural clouds of our Dolls.
In any case, let's try talking to her.
Is this "Signore Giuseppe" the original user of this account?
Probably. I think you might need to do some roleplay. Just improvise while you talk to her; we might find out more.
Alright, I'll give that a try.
We're here, Signore Giuseppe. Please take a seat.
I'm so glad I've prepared snacks beforehand so our tea party could start on time.
Thank you, the tea is wonderful.
Henrietta...isn't it? Have you been here the whole time?
Yes, I've been waiting for you ever since you left. I wanted to be the first to welcome you home...
You must've been very busy. May I ask what you've been doing?
Hmm...nothing out of the usual.
So it was a mission with Section 1?
Section 1?
Yeah...I suppose.
I see... So it really was a covert operation.
You mentioned no Cyborgs were allowed on the mission so I suspected it had something to do with Section 1.
But that's okay, we've all been waiting for you to come back.
"We"?
I look around. The garden is charming but empty. A building is partially obscured in the distance. But no matter how I look at it, Henrietta and I appear to be the only people in the garden.
Are you looking for Triela and the others? They're out playing.
We've all been waiting for a long time so they've all headed off to do their own thing.
Who's Triela...?
Never mind, let's leave that for now.
Henrietta, have you seen any strangers lately?
Strangers? I did see quite a lot of them the past few days...
What kind of strangers are we talking about?

choices: A. A tall, cheerful girl with red hair.
B. A gloomy-looking girl with purple hair and a green cape.
C. A clumsy girl with bluish gray hair.
D. A girl with dazzling blonde curls.

spans.text: A red-headed girl...? I did see a distinctive Cyborg like that, but I wouldn't say she's particularly tall. Her hair was in twin tails and she was wearing what looked like a custom-made ceremonial dress.
She's with Angelica right now.
A girl with purple hair... I did see her. She seemed really shy.
She's with Triela.
Oh, you mean the lady in the immaculate uniform! She was dressed like a military police officer. She looked really awe-inspiring but was very approachable at the same time...
She's with Rico.
Many women match that description...
Her hair is especially fluffy. It's fanned out like this.
Oh, now that you mention it, I remember seeing something like that. She came in a pumpkin – like that princess in the fairy tale.
She's with Claes.
...Are they enemies...or maybe spies from the Five Republics?
No, no, they're not enemies. They're my friends.
Her hands ball up into fists as she clutches at the hem of her dress.
...I see. Friends, you say...?
Then I suppose I'll have to thank them.
Thank them?
They must be your new Fratello, that's why you've come back to look for them, right?
But...I miss you so much... So you didn't come back for me?
Has she been waiting for the owner of this account the whole time? She still doesn't know she's been abandoned? That's kinda sad.
Don't worry... Henrietta, I did come back for you.
Hmmm... ehehe
What is it?
Nothing... I'm just very happy to hear you say that, Signore Giuseppe.
It has always been like this between the two of us - "there's no need for words between brothers and sisters."
Right... Hold on, brothers and sisters?
You mean us?
Have you forgotten, Signore Giuseppe?
We're partners working for the Social Welfare Agency – a "Fratello".
You're my Handler, and I'm your Cyborg. As Cyborgs, we protect our Handler with our own life and do everything we can to help you fulfill your wish.
Kalin, some explanation, please?
On it. I searched the database and found an explanatory document of the setting. Sending it to you right now.
Kalina sends me the document and I skim through it quickly without letting Henrietta know.
In the setting, the "Social Welfare Agency" is a special service department within the government that operates under the facade of a welfare organization.

They take in girls who fell victims to unfortunate accidents and give them a second chance at life by converting them into Cyborg assassins. They are then paired with agents known as "Handlers" and undertake missions for the government under the table.
Cyborgs... They're similar to T-Dolls, but also vastly different.
The fact that they're called Cyborgs means these are living, breathing human beings with flesh and blood. Their "Handlers" must've carried a much heavier burden than us T-Doll Commanders.
So the owner of this account played the role of a "Handler"? Then I suppose it makes sense why he never came back.
Still, what has all this got to do with our Dolls?
Looks like I must start investigating this girl to get to the bottom of this.
Signore Giuseppe?
Sorry, I spaced out for a bit.
...You're right, of course.
I'm sorry for not coming back earlier. The mission took a lot longer than I'd thought.
It's alright, missions from the Agency always come first.
Besides, I don't mind waiting because I know you'd come back the second you can!
Uh... Indeed.
Henrietta, do you mind showing me to the new...Cyborgs?
Don't you want to stay a little longer?
You literally just came back...
Or do they matter more than me?
I notice an odd gleam in Henrietta's eyes.

The Agency demand absolute loyalty from their Cyborgs, so they brainwash the girls through a "Conditioning" process to make them obey their Handlers without question, but this pure devotion instilled by their Conditioning would inevitably get twisted into something else.
Which is why I must tread carefully when communicating with this girl.
Those girls have information concerning our previous mission and I need that information.
Oh...is that so...
Henrietta's eyes soften, much to my relief.
But even I don't know their exact location.
Why?
Have you forgotten about that as well? Look at that building. That's "Vita".
You told us we could spend our free time there while you were out with Signore Jean and the others.
Vita?
That's right. In this place called Vita, we can wish for anything; we can create the perfect world for ourselves to play freely in.
Angelica, Rico, Triela, and Claes are all in there.
What about you?
The question seems to have caught her off-guard and made her a bit uncomfortable. She hunches up in the chair while her eyes dart around frantically.
Henrietta?
I...I was waiting for you to come back.
I didn't want to go there on my own... I thought it'd only be appropriate if I went together with you, Signore Giuseppe.
I...I see.
Then when are they coming out?
Hmm...I'm not sure, but it's probably going to take a while.
I'm afraid I can't wait that long.
Then let's go find them together!
You can come with me!
Going into Vita? Just like that?
Is there a problem?
N-no, let's set off right away.
Okie~ Ehehe~
As if suppressing strong feelings, she takes my hand and pulls me toward the building outside the garden.
The sun shines through the foliage and sprinkles Henrietta's smiling face with spots of light and shadow. For some reason, I feel strangely protective of her.
Are these girls' stories just fiction? Or did they actually happen somewhere and were somehow documented in this stretch of cyberspace?
With these questions buzzing in my head, I am led by Henrietta into the building known as "Vita".
